events.title: Brisbane Art and Craft Show
events.location: Brisbane Convention & Exhibition Centre, South Brisbane
events.description: A two-day art and craft show featuring various local makers and artists, offering free admission to explore creative works and possibly engage with creators. This is a recurring annual event.

events.title: Lifeline Bookfest Brisbane
events.location: Brisbane Convention & Exhibition Centre, South Brisbane
events.description: A massive community book sale supporting Lifeline, offering thousands of pre-loved books across various genres. It's a popular recurring event that attracts a wide range of book lovers.

events.title: GOMA Friday Nights
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art, South Brisbane
events.description: Experience GOMA's exhibitions and spaces during a special late-night opening, offering an atmospheric way to explore contemporary art. This particular event marks the final Friday night of the season for this program.

events.title: Rusalka (Opera Season)
events.description: Experience Dvořák's enchanting opera 'Rusalka', presented as part of QPAC's season. This theatrical and musical production runs for multiple dates from late June into early July.

events.title: Open Season Live Music Program
events.location: Various venues across Brisbane (e.g., The Tivoli, The Princess Theatre)
events.description: A citywide festival of live music, 'Open Season' showcases diverse artists across multiple iconic Brisbane venues. Expect a range of genres and intimate performances, fostering Brisbane's music scene.
